name: Scaffold
description: A system built around a neural language model that extends its capabilities (e.g., recursive self-calls, REPL interaction, infinite context). The author argues scaffolds ARE the future form of language models, not mere wrappers.

edges.quote: a powerful class of language models with near-infinite input, output, and reasoning context are scaffolds around neural language models that can call themselves recursively inside of a REPL
investing in scaffolding (like linting, validation, and non-trivial testing) to check AI output automatically
